https://sansec.io/research/stylesmuggler.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce remote code execution
https://sansec.io/research/stylesmuggler.overview: Sansec reports active exploitation of a Magento and Adobe Commerce remote-code-execution flaw. Its investigation describes backdoor processes, command-and-control traffic over TLS and NTP-looking UDP, and recommended patching and compromise checks.

https://www.sentinelone.com/labs/dont-ca.title: TraderTraitor backdoors resurface on an IT-services victim
https://www.sentinelone.com/labs/dont-ca.overview: SentinelOne describes job-interview lures that use modified Terraform lock files to install macOS backdoors. The report examines an IT-services victim outside cryptocurrency, attacker-controlled infrastructure, and how the malware sought cloud credentials and API access.

https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-c.title: AI-powered espionage campaign targets Linux infrastructure
https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-c.overview: Unit 42 reports a campaign against Linux infrastructure involving web shells, custom backdoors, reconnaissance, and attempts to extract sensitive data. The report lists associated network indicators and discusses defensive investigation steps.

https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security.title: Star Blizzard refines phishing and RedFlick malware delivery
https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security.overview: Microsoft describes phishing campaigns that used RedFlick to deliver the CosmicPulse backdoor. The report explains the Windows infection flow, persistence techniques, and network indicators for investigation.
